snippet.title: Velanit: The Forgotten Cottage | Official Trailer and Kickstarter Announcement 🎉
snippet.description:
Velanit: The Forgotten Cottage is a cozy pixel art renovation game set in a Mediterranean coastal town during the Renaissance era. Restore an abandoned cottage, explore the countryside, craft and decorate, and uncover the mystery its former owner left behind 🔍✨

I worked very hard making this game and to continue making it and deliver the game I know it can be, I would love your support 💖 The game will launch on Kickstarter on Tuesday, May 5th at 8am ET / 2pm CET and every single backer means the world to me 🥹💖 You can follow the pre-launch page to be notified when the campaign goes live!👇🏻

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ivasan/velanit-the-forgotten-cottage

Also, during my Kickstarter campaign I will be hosting the first playtest on Steam! 🥹
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4411690/Velanit_The_Forgotten_Cottage

🎁 Join my new Discord during the Kickstarter and get a special role + an exclusive celebration costume for your character on release day 👀
(if you're still around by then 🤭) 👇🏻
https://discord.gg/SzPdgYDUDf
